templates.source: Legacy Wyze RTSP firmware for Wyze Cam v2, Wyze Cam v3 and Wyze Cam Pan. Official Wyze support article 'Wyze Cam RTSP' (support.wyze.com/hc/en-us/articles/360026245231-Wyze-Cam-RTSP): RTSP is a separate optional firmware you flash (copy .bin to a microSD card, insert, boot), then Settings > Advanced Settings > RTSP > set 4-10 char user/pass (a-z, 0-9 only) > 'Generate URL'. The generated URL uses port 8554 and path /live, i.e. rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:8554/live (default RTSP port 554 is NOT used by this firmware). Confirmed against the iSpy/Agent DVR crowd catalog (ispyconnect.com/camera/wyzecam) and multiple firmware install guides referencing the Wyze KB flow.

Newer official Wyze RTSP feature for Wyze Cam v3 and Wyze Cam Pan v3 (released Feb 2026, firmware 4.36.x / 4.55.x). Wyze's own RTSP testing/setup instructions (wyze-beta.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/rtsp.html) document: unsecured rtsp://{ip}:554/stream0/ and secured rtsps://{ip}:322/stream0/ (the default port may be omitted). Enabled via Device Settings > Advanced Settings > RTSP; not on by default. Different port (554/322) and path (/stream0) than the legacy v2/v3/Pan RTSP firmware above.

notes: Wyze cameras do NOT ship with RTSP enabled — RTSP is an optional feature that must be turned on, and on the older cameras it requires flashing a SEPARATE optional RTSP firmware. There are TWO official Wyze RTSP families with DIFFERENT ports and paths: (1) Legacy RTSP firmware for Wyze Cam v2, Wyze Cam v3 and Wyze Cam Pan (v1) — flash the RTSP .bin via microSD, then Settings > Advanced Settings > RTSP > Generate URL produces rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:8554/live (port 8554, path /live). Wyze pulled these legacy firmware files for a period and treats them as an aging beta with no active maintenance. (2) Newer built-in official RTSP for Wyze Cam v3 and Wyze Cam Pan v3 (Feb 2026, fw 4.36.x/4.55.x) — no separate flash, enabled in-app; uses rtsp://{ip}:554/stream0 (unsecured) or rtsps://{ip}:322/stream0 (encrypted). Credentials are set in-app (4-10 chars, a-z/0-9). Other models (v4, OG, newer Pan) have no official RTSP firmware and rely on the community Docker-Wyze-Bridge instead (out of scope). Default port recorded as 8554 for the primary/legacy family; the /stream0 template documents the 554/322 newer family.
